name: Telemetry Relay
description: Sends live telemetry (positions, item pickups, match events) from game instances to ql-stats-hub through a relay on each host. Needs the stats-hub URL and token in Settings, the host's Telemetry Relay on and the stream_telemetry_unified plugin; each instance has a Telemetry switch.

host_relay.description: Relay sidecar that forwards telemetry from every instance on this host to the stats-hub target below, or to the cluster-wide default when left blank. Enabling lets this host's IP through the stats-hub firewall, and turning the relay off takes it out again unless the Demo Stream Tunnel is still on.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Deploys and starts the relay sidecar on this host.

fields.label: Stats-hub URL override
fields.description: Leave blank to use the cluster-wide default.

fields.label: Ingest token override
fields.description: Leave blank to use the cluster-wide default.

fields.label: Forward through
fields.description: Only for a host that cannot reach stats-hub directly: the sidecar sends its POSTs to this address (http://host:port, a relay that forwards to stats-hub) instead. qlsm itself still talks to the stats-hub URL. stats-hub then sees the relay's address, so that address must be allowed in its firewall. Leave blank to send straight to stats-hub.

instance_telemetry.description: Sends this instance's telemetry to ql-stats-hub through the host relay. Switching it on or off applies the config and restarts the instance; the server ID is reserved automatically and kept when switched off.

fields.label: Send telemetry
fields.description: Needs the Telemetry Relay on this host and the stream_telemetry_unified plugin on the instance.

fields.label: Reserve a new server ID
fields.description: Asks stats-hub for a fresh server ID on save; use it when two servers share one. Untick it after saving.

global_settings.description: Cluster-wide stats-hub target. Individual hosts may override both values.

fields.label: Stats-hub URL
fields.description: Default ql-stats-hub base URL every host's relay forwards to.

fields.label: Ingest token
fields.description: STATS_HUB_INGEST_TOKEN, not STATS_HUB_API_TOKEN. The wrong one fails silently with a 401 that trips the circuit breaker on every feed.
